questions.questionText: The speeds of a boat in still water and of the stream are in the ratio 5:2. What is the ratio of the time taken to go upstream to the time taken to go downstream over the same distance?
questions.explanation: Let boat = 5x and stream = 2x. Downstream = 7x, upstream = 3x. Time is inversely proportional to speed, so up : down = (7) : (3) = 7:3.
questions.shortcut: Time up : time down = (u + v) : (u - v).

questions.questionText: The speeds of a boat in still water and of the stream are in the ratio 5:3. What is the ratio of the time taken to go upstream to the time taken to go downstream over the same distance?
questions.explanation: Let boat = 5x and stream = 3x. Downstream = 8x, upstream = 2x. Time is inversely proportional to speed, so up : down = (8) : (2) = 4:1.
questions.shortcut: Time up : time down = (u + v) : (u - v).

questions.questionText: The stream flows at 2 km/h. A boat takes 2 times as long to go upstream as downstream over the same distance. What is the speed of the boat in still water?
questions.shortcut: Set (u + v)/(u - v) = k and solve for u.

questions.questionText: The stream flows at 3 km/h. A boat takes 2 times as long to go upstream as downstream over the same distance. What is the speed of the boat in still water?
questions.shortcut: Set (u + v)/(u - v) = k and solve for u.

questions.questionText: A boat goes 76 km downstream in 4 hours and 27 km upstream in 3 hours. What is its speed in still water?
questions.explanation: Downstream = 76/4 = 19, upstream = 27/3 = 9. Boat = (19 + 9)/2 = 14 km/h.
questions.shortcut: Find both speeds first; the boat's speed is their average.

questions.questionText: A boat goes 44 km downstream in 2 hours and 8 km upstream in 4 hours. What is its speed in still water?
questions.explanation: Downstream = 44/2 = 22, upstream = 8/4 = 2. Boat = (22 + 2)/2 = 12 km/h.
questions.shortcut: Find both speeds first; the boat's speed is their average.

questions.questionText: A boat goes 90 km downstream in 5 hours and 10 km upstream in 5 hours. What is its speed in still water?

questions.shortcut: Find both speeds first; the boat's speed is their average.

questions.questionText: A boat goes 68 km downstream in 4 hours and 18 km upstream in 2 hours. What is the speed of the stream?
questions.explanation: Downstream = 17, upstream = 9. Stream = (17 - 9)/2 = 4 km/h.
questions.shortcut: Half the difference of the two speeds.

questions.questionText: A boat goes 63 km downstream in 3 hours and 38 km upstream in 2 hours. How many hours will it take to cover 100 km in still water?
questions.explanation: Downstream = 21, upstream = 19, so boat = 20 km/h. Time in still water = 100/20 = 5 hours.
questions.shortcut: Find the still-water speed, then time = distance / speed.
